new_statement: Because h=h^dagger and (u bold-dot h)^dagger=h bold-dot u^dagger, the associator axiom gives ||X^dagger bold-dot X-h bold-dot(u^dagger bold-dot(u bold-dot h))|| <= e*||h||*||u^dagger||*||u bold-dot h||. Since ||h||<=1+delta<2, ||u^dagger||=||u||<=2, and ||u bold-dot h||<5, this is <=20*e. More precisely, it is <20*e when e>0, while when e=0 the associator axiom makes it equal to 0.
